title: nasturtium palustre var. tanacetifolium
intro: Nasturtium palustre var. tanacetifolium, commonly known as Marsh Cress, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It has been used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help in reducing symptoms of respiratory issues like bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Cress include its use as an expectorant and anti-catarrhal, helping to relieve congestion and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Marsh Cress include isothiocyanates, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal properties, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
